reason: Provides one-way email reminders from an AI agent for completion, blockage, decision requests, and long-task milestones using a bundled Node SMTP sender and user-supplied configuration.

summaries.zh: 为离开电脑时运行的智能体提供基于SMTP的邮件提醒，在任务完成、受阻、需要决策或达到里程碑时通知用户。
summaries.en: Provides SMTP-based email reminders from an AI agent when tasks finish, become blocked, require a decision, or reach a milestone.

capabilities: Sends email notifications through configured SMTP services
Reads SMTP configuration including an authorization code and recipient address
Triggers notifications when an agent goal completes, is blocked, needs a decision, or reaches a milestone
